name: Spend a Crate
hint: The spring keeps the first crate it gets. Make it worth it.
catch: the far pan sits past a spring, at the end of the only lane a crate can travel. The first crate down that lane is lost to the spring — spend it, and the next one rolls across onto the pan. Weighed, the bridge pan meets you at your height and settles to the star's; unweighed, it sinks under you.
